itinerary.title: Mountain Culture and Valleys of the Beas

estimatedCostPerPerson.note: Covers private SUV transfers from Chandigarh, mid-range boutique stays, breakfast, and local guide fees. It excludes flights and the Rohtang Pass permit fee which varies by season.

days.title: The drive from Chandigarh to the mountains
days.morning: Start the journey from Chandigarh airport or station in a private SUV. The road passes through the plains of Punjab before climbing into the Shivalik hills.
days.afternoon: Continue the drive along the Beas river through the Aut tunnel and past the Pandoh Dam. This is a long transit day with several mountain bends.
days.evening: Check into a riverside property in the log-hut area or near the Beas. Have a quiet dinner at the stay to acclimatise to the 2,050-metre altitude.
days.stay: Riverside boutique resort or wooden cottage in the Log Hut area
days.meals: Stop for parathas and curd at a roadside dhaba near Bilaspur.
tips: Keep motion sickness medication handy for the winding roads after Kiratpur.
The Aut tunnel can have heavy traffic; expect delays.

days.title: Old Manali lanes and Hadimba Temple
days.morning: Walk through the cedar forests to reach the 16th-century Hadimba Devi Temple. Observe the intricate wood carvings and the surrounding Dhungri Van Vihar park.
days.afternoon: Cross the bridge into Old Manali to explore the narrow lanes lined with cafes and small shops. Visit the Manu Temple at the highest point of the village.
days.evening: Spend time by the Manalsu River or browse the local silver and hemp shops in the old village.
days.stay: Riverside boutique resort or wooden cottage in the Log Hut area
days.meals: Try trout fish prepared in the local style or wood-fired pizzas in Old Manali cafes.
tips: Wear comfortable walking shoes with good grip for the steep Old Manali incline.
Visit the temple early to avoid the mid-day tourist bus crowds.

days.title: High altitude views at Solang or Rohtang
days.morning: Drive towards Solang Valley for views of the glaciers and snow-capped peaks. If the pass is open and permits are secured, continue toward Rohtang Pass.
days.afternoon: Spend time at the Solang ropeway or take a short hike to the Anjani Mahadev waterfall. The terrain here is rocky and can be windy.
days.evening: Return to the main town and walk through the Tibetan Monastery on Mall Road. Observe the local artisans making traditional carpets.
days.stay: Riverside boutique resort or wooden cottage in the Log Hut area
days.meals: Look for Siddu, a traditional steamed bread filled with walnuts and spices, sold by local vendors.
days.travelTime: 2 to 4 hours round trip depending on traffic and snow conditions
tips: Rohtang permits must be booked online in advance and are limited.
Carry a heavy jacket even in summer as temperatures drop significantly at the pass.

days.title: Art and heritage in Naggar village
days.morning: Drive 20km south to Naggar, the former capital of Kullu. Explore the Naggar Castle, a unique example of western Himalayan architecture using stone and wood.
days.afternoon: Visit the Nicholas Roerich Art Gallery to see paintings of the Himalayas. Walk down to the Tripura Sundari temple, a multi-tiered pagoda-style structure.
days.evening: Enjoy the sunset from the castle balcony overlooking the Kullu valley before heading back to Manali.
days.stay: Riverside boutique resort or wooden cottage in the Log Hut area
days.meals: Have lunch at a heritage cafe in Naggar featuring local fruit preserves and honey.
days.travelTime: 2 hours round trip by private car
tips: The Naggar Castle is a great spot for photography without the usual Manali crowds.
Check for local festivals at the Tripura Sundari temple which often feature traditional dance.

days.title: Riverside walks and local markets
days.morning: Take a relaxed walk through the Nature Park between Old and New Manali, where deodar trees shade the path along the Beas river.
days.afternoon: Visit the local market near the bus stand for Kullu shawls and dry fruits. This is a good time to visit the less-frequented Vashisht village for the hot springs.
days.evening: Have a final mountain dinner in one of the garden restaurants in the lower Manali area.
days.stay: Riverside boutique resort or wooden cottage in the Log Hut area
days.meals: Sample different varieties of local apples or apricot jam from the government outlet.
tips: Be wary of 'pure saffron' sold on the streets; it is often fake.
The Vashisht hot springs have separate areas for men and women.

days.title: Descent to the plains
days.morning: Begin the long drive back down to Chandigarh. Ensure an early start to account for potential roadwork or truck traffic in the Mandi district.
days.afternoon: Stop for lunch near Sundernagar. The landscape transitions from pine forests back to the broad-leafed trees of the lower hills.
days.evening: Arrive in Chandigarh by late evening for your flight or train.
days.meals: North Indian lunch at a highway rest stop.
tips: Book a flight departing after 8:00 PM to ensure you have enough buffer for the drive.
Keep a small bag with essentials for the car journey as the main luggage stays in the boot.
